description: Trunk-based development keeps everyone integrating small changes into one shared branch, usually main, at least daily. Developers commit directly or use very short-lived branches, with automated tests keeping trunk healthy and feature flags hiding unfinished work. Frequent integration limits how far work can diverge and supports frequent releases, but depends on reliable checks and small changes.

branches.label: trunk (main)
branches.description: The single shared line everyone integrates into, at least daily. Always kept green by automated tests and feature flags.

branches.label: short-lived branch
branches.description: Optional, hours-to-days-lived branch for work that cannot be committed directly. Merged back to trunk frequently; often avoided in favor of branch-by-abstraction.
